svg.title: RepostGuard-Lite M2 and M3 architecture
svg.desc: A shared semantic and forensic feature extractor feeds either the static M2 fusion head or the quality-conditioned M3 fusion head. A paired clean and degraded training objective is shown below.
svg.text: Shared semantic–forensic encoders with static (M2) or quality-conditioned (M3) fusion
quality weights change branch contribution, not the classifier
Paired Robustness Training for M2 / M3
